tools.name: check_page
tools.description: Check whether a web page's Meta, TikTok and OpenAI pixels work (the Meta Pixel is the former Facebook Pixel), with a grade for each: cookie consent, duplicate events, event IDs, the ad click IDs (e.g. fbclid -> _fbc) and signs of server-side tracking. A browser in the EU visits the page twice. Reuse

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Read the result of a check by its report id or report link (https://ispixelworking.com/r/<id>): status, a grade for each pixel found (Meta, TikTok and OpenAI), problems with explanations and fix guide links, checklist. Reports are kept for 90 days.

tools.name: get_fix_guide
tools.description: Step-by-step guide (Markdown) for fixing a problem the check found, for the site's platform when one exists (otherwise the general version). With consent_tool, returns the guide for wiring the Meta Pixel to that consent tool instead. Guides exist for: meta.fires_before_consent, meta.not_firing_after

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: Every problem (finding) the check can report, with id, severity, title, explanation and whether a fix guide exists.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_page" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
